Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface Drawable

public interface Drawable
One generation-bound evaluated Cubism drawable (ArtMesh).

Core-style fields such as flags, orders, opacity, colors, masks, vertices, and indices are evaluation/result reads. Indexed sequences are immutable views and do not hand out mutable backend arrays. Optional Editor properties and writes are available only when the active provider can establish their authoring semantics; API presence does not imply support on every Cubism version.
